label: Unreal Engine forums: Job Offerings
terms_note: Forum posts; contact by DM/e-mail — human lane.

endpoints.call: the Discourse category RSS (application/rss+xml) and .json (public Discourse API) can be read as a feed at a gentle cadence, noting robots.txt disallows /c/*.rss for crawlers
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. Epic Developer Community Forums (Discourse): category .rss and .json answer publicly; the ToS page returned 403 to the audit host so the automation clauses were not read; robots.txt has 28 rules incl. Disallow: / for unlisted agents.

search.note: The forum runs Discourse, whose public API (https://docs.discourse.org) serves GET /search.json?q=… without a key for public categories. The query is scoped to the Job Offerings category with Discourse's '#<category>' option ('#got-skills-looking-for-talent:job-offerings', category id 76) and ordered newest first ('order:latest'); page pages the results (Discourse returns up to 50 per page and sets grouped_search_result.more_full_page_results when there are more). Postings are community forum topics (paid, royalty and unpaid offers mixed; the title usually carries a [PAID]/[UNPAID] tag), id is the topic id (use it with get_posting), and the topic URL is https://forums.unrealengine.com/t/{slug}/{id}. Matching posts' blurbs and authors are in the response's posts[] (not mapped). Keep polling gentle; this is a community forum.

get_posting.note: GET /t/{id}.json 'Get a single topic'; description is the opening post's HTML (post_stream.posts[0].cooked, where the poster describes the role and how to contact them); slug, category_id, tags and the reply posts are in raw.

not_offered.me: Public, keyless reads; there is no account to verify without a Discourse user API key.
not_offered.apply: The job offers are forum topics; candidates reply or contact the poster by forum message or the e-mail given in the post — there is no application endpoint.
not_offered.list_messages: Reading private messages needs a Discourse user API key for a forums.unrealengine.com account (Epic account sign-in), which this keyless adapter does not use.

live_check.notes: one 429 in the full run after deals/unreal_forums_jobs hit the same Discourse host; clean on rerun; all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
